title: Pangram classifies award-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated while publisher upholds award
summary: AI text detector Pangram flagged 99 percent of David Silva Rojas's prize-winning novel Donde el agua trabaja as machine-generated, but publisher Almadía affirmed the manuscript's authenticity following internal documentation review.
research_notes:
Submit text excerpts or full manuscripts to the detector interface to generate statistical probability scores across individual document segments.

Never treat automated detector probability scores as sole grounds for disqualification; corroborate findings against author drafts, interview notes, and editorial review.

Account for regional dialects, oral histories, and non-standard narrative rhythm, which frequently trigger high false-positive rates in statistical classifiers.
